notes: Read all 198 source lines line by line before editing. Every line is accounted for below; behaviour, state names, API paths, unit handling (none — raw signal values stay on the wire), i18n keys+defaults, and the page's section order (header actions -> error banner -> no-vehicle empty -> controls panel -> not-queried empty / history table) are preserved. The native file header documents every web->native remap.

Unit handling: this page queries RAW signal history values and renders them as-is (no distance/speed/energy formatting), so there is no SI display-boundary conversion to apply — the Phase-48 frontend-SI-cutover rule is satisfied trivially (nothing converted on either side).

Lint/type notes: react-hooks/exhaustive-deps (error) satisfied — fromIso[start]/toIso[end]/handleQuery[canQuery]/rows[allRows,page,perPage] and the inline shims' deps match web. Dynamic colour styles (signal dot/text via CHART_COLORS, type-badge tone) use computed style entries (allowed). No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, or Leaflet are imported — only react, react-native primitives (View/ScrollView/Pressable/Modal/Animated/ActivityIndicator/TextInput/StyleSheet/Platform), @tanstack/react-query, the shared native SemanticIcon/AppText/GlassPanel/theme tokens, and the ported parity request/useSignals/useVehicles/types/DatePresetChips/datePresets/CHART_COLORS.

Gates run from apps/native: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit), `npm run lint -- --quiet` (eslint . --quiet), and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` (jest). The new page is self-contained and imported by no existing test, so the suite is unaffected.
